registry.item_title: Number of Participants With With First Occurrence of All-Cause Mortality

item_title_witness.text: Number of Participants With With First Occurrence of All-Cause Mortality

notes: Registry outcomeMeasuresModule contains the all-cause mortality outcome. It reports only separate classes: During treatment (OG000: 6; OG001: 5), Within 30 days of treatment discontinuation (OG000: 1; OG001: 1), and After 30 days of treatment discontinuation (OG000: 10; OG001: 4). No overall event count is printed for either group in this measure; summing is prohibited. Overall events and event witnesses are therefore null. The abstract prints the served overall counts (17 and 10), but registry ownership is mandatory for this outcome, so prose counts are not substituted. Registry denominators 111 and 110 match served totals. The adverseEventsModule has no all-cause mortality totals; its Sudden death and Sudden cardiac death terms are narrower outcomes.
